steps.name: Yu Cheng
steps.text: You sure are lucky.

steps.name: Yu Cheng
steps.text: All my years at the Judicial Review Office, and you are the first I have seen who has the chance to get out of this damn prison alive.

steps.name: Gu Quan
steps.text: I myself never expected it to turn out this way.

steps.name: Yu Cheng
steps.text: Hmph. That's what's wrong with all you clerical types. Always living for the day, never thinking about the consequences.

steps.name: Yu Cheng
steps.text: All that time spent researching, all those years of blood, sweat and tears, all for a dish at the Feast and one very angry Lung.

steps.name: Yu Cheng
steps.text: You caused quite the ruckus and ended up in here. Are you happy?

steps.name: Gu Quan
steps.text: It is as you say...

steps.name: Gu Quan
steps.text: But my deeds were loyal and just. This, I know. My conscience is clear.

steps.name: Yu Cheng
steps.text: Those who peer into finponds to find omens will see omens... So, what comes next in your plans?

steps.name: Gu Quan
steps.text: The order to transfer has already been issued. I will be joining the diplomatic mission to Victoria in three days.

steps.name: Gu Quan
steps.text: After all that happened, I can no longer stay in Baizao. These arrangements are the fruit of Minister Ning's efforts.

steps.name: Yu Cheng
steps.text: Victoria? How are you supposed to get to Victoria with a body like yours?

steps.name: Gu Quan
steps.text: To be favored with a pardon is all I need ask for.

steps.name: Gu Quan
steps.text: Besides, I can consider going to Victoria returning home...

steps.name: Yu Cheng
steps.text: Can you really? I remember you saying your wife and child already passed away, no?

steps.name: Gu Quan
steps.text: Yes... It has been many years since that day.

steps.name: Yu Cheng
steps.text: ...Even if I did believe you, do you think other people will?

steps.name: Yu Cheng
steps.text: If you can remember things that happened back then, so can others.

steps.name: Yu Cheng
steps.text: Do you know how many eyes will be watching you when you return?

steps.name: Gu Quan
steps.text: What am I to do...? Please, speak plainly.

steps.name: Yu Cheng
steps.text: Lend me your life, my friend.

steps.name: Yu Cheng
steps.text: That unvarnished truth you crave? I will give it to you.
The first time I came to Baizao to further my studies left a deep impression on me. Skyscrapers that blotted out the heavens, an unending sea of brilliant lights.
And in the center of all those lights was the Forbidden City.
A thousand feet it teetered, its lofty heights unseen from the ground.
My teacher said this was where every policy was decided, where every decree was handed down, each one affecting the lives of untold commoners. A duty heavier than mountains.
And thus it is here that every student can put to use all they have learned.
To serve the lands and the people.
But when I stood here, in the flesh, facing that palace of edifice and high walls—
I felt a chill sap away my breath.

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: You have arrived early, Mr. Liang.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Miss Ning...?

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: Hmm? You seem surprised. Do you not wish to see me?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Hardly.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: I simply had not heard you would also be attending the Feast of a Hundred Delicacies, Miss Ning.

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: Minister Ning is ill, so for this year's Feast, the Ministry of Rites had no choice but to send me to attend in his stead.

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: It was a rather last-minute decision, so I did not have the time to tell you, my Lord.

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: I suppose that leaves us equals in silence, since it seems you never planned to tell me you were attending either.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: I am merely here as part of my work. I did not wish to bother you, Miss Ning.

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: I am suddenly reminded of how, aside from Shangshu, we have not met for the better part of a year. Several of my letters to you during that time received no answer.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: It can be hard to put words to paper, and I find myself often mired in official business. I have been negligent in maintaining my side of the conversation.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: I cannot deny your blame, Miss Ning.

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: Where have I mentioned blaming you, my Lord?

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: During your time as magistrate, even the smallest needs of your hometown never left your thoughts. Now with expanded duties? The concerns have only increased.

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: But for some reason, after only six short months, I feel as though we have become estranged.

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: As if there are some things... we cannot say to the other.

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: Putting that aside for the moment, this is the first time you are attending the Feast, yes?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Yes. My early years were spent in Shangshu, so I had little opportunity to take part in government events such as this.

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: Major topics are often deliberated upon during these Feasts.

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: The question this year is, what decision will His Majesty make in regards to this war?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: I dare not make any sort of wild conjecture on His Majesty's thoughts.

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: But you are a clever man, Mr. Liang. Your conjectures are always correct.

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: You did in fact have something on your mind the other day, and you wanted to discuss it with Grandfather, did you not?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: I dare not lie to you, Miss Ning.

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: Phrase it how you will. I am always happy to hear that you wish to see me.

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: But I am afraid that for you, I have never been someone to be trusted, or to entrust things with.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: I believe there may have been a misunderstanding, Miss Ning...

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: I do not mean to blame you.

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: Who among us did not detest the murky secrets of the bureaucracy when these red robes were first draped over us? But now, we must navigate all this wheeling and dealing, like it or not.

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: I may not be close to the center of the court, but there is one thing even I know.

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: It is difficult to speak the truth, and even more difficult to make others believe you are speaking the truth.

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: Once you enter the palace walls, the word 'sincerity' means less than nothing.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: But all I have ever shown you is sincerity, Miss Ning.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: No matter what may come, I have always hoped you would remember—

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: We should take our seats now, Mr. Liang. Let us head inside.

steps.name: Veteran Chef
steps.text: Come on, step on it! Check over your ingredients one last time when you're done! The guests are already seated! We need to start serving as soon as the order comes in!

steps.name: Veteran Chef
steps.text: Inspect ALL your ingredients! Check on the stews and soups while you're at it!

steps.name: Nervous Young Chef
steps.text: The Bliss Soup on stove number ninety... I don't know how, but the color seems to be a bit off.

steps.name: Veteran Chef
steps.text: What?! How many times did I say to cut the ingredients into finger-width cubes! No more, no less! And it's supposed to be on the fire for twenty hours! No breaks! Someone must have screwed something up!

steps.name: Veteran Chef
steps.text: *sigh*...! Alright, move aside, I'll come have a look!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: (Quietly) Hey... Over here!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Why're you still wearing those clothes?! Scared people won't notice you or something?

spans.text: Why're you still wearing those clothes?! Scared people

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Formal dress for formal occasions. I had kept these clothes at home just in case.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: But this is the kitchen! Don't you have anything more... suitable to put on?

spans.text: ! Don't you have anything more... suitable to put on?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hey!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Is disguising yourself not something natural for Judicial Officers?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: What nonsense are you talking about? Deputy Minister at the Judicial Review Office is not some undercover ghost—

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Though I have found myself sneaking around a lot lately for some reason...

spans.text: found myself sneaking around a lot lately for some reason...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Alright, enough muttering, change into these clothes. You follow the army of waiters into the banquet area as they're serving up the dishes, then change back into your fancy robe when you can.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Fine...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hah... This kind of infiltration really does make me a little nervous...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: You said you were going to stand up to see justice restored, so if you make the True Lung mad, is he just going to arrest you right away, or is he going to...

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: There is a tradition of remonstration during the Feast of a Hundred Delicacies. Besides, we're just going to request a reopening of an old case due to inconclusive evidence. Why would the True Lung be mad at me?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Although there is one thing...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Which is?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Have you ever thought about... What if...

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: What if the truth we manage to dig up on this case turned out to be the complete opposite of what we thought...

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: What if... you found out everything around you was one big lie...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: What are you talking about?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Didn't we do all this to get to the truth in the first place? If it's a lie, we'll smash it to pieces! Why the hesitation?!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: We've come this far already. What choice do we even have?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Blaze... I think... Your father, he... He was likely a good man.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Huh? Why this all of a sudden?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Promise me this. If something unexpected happens, you must take care of yourself fir—

spans.text: Promise me this. If something unexpected happens, you

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Shh! Someone's coming, hide! Under the stove!

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: Is everything ready?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: R—Ready, chef.

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: These longevity noodles you are in charge of may be simple, but they are still vital for the feast. Make no mistakes while preparing them.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: U—Understood.

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: Although I do not know why your shifu did not wish to come to the Feast, I believe he had his reasons to choose you.

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: Once the Feast is over, I will give you the opportunity to take on my mantle.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Eh? Me?

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: Not happy to hear that?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hahaha... There's a lot of chefs who would pinch themselves awake if they were told they were going to be your apprentice.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: But I don't understand. Why're you entrusting all the skills you've learned your entire life to only one person?

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: Nonsense... Do you know just how many examinations a Ding Feng Lou head chef puts their prospective students through before they choose an apprentice?

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: Not to mention the fact that my own shifu was the one who penned the 'Book of Foods' with recipes from all four major cuisines and has served us well for decades worth of Feasts.

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: Out of the hundreds of chefs in this Ding Feng Lou kitchen who have honed their craft for many years, Shifu chose me to take the reins. Just me.

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: Generations of exquisite artisanship in these hands, you'd let anybody smudge it?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: But, no matter how exquisite the artisanship is, you're making the dish for people to eat...

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: ...Hmmm?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Haha... What I mean is, is teaching a single apprentice who's as good as you really more important than teaching a bunch of chefs who can do a decent job...?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: The more you teach, the more can cook, which means even more of Yan can enjoy tastier food, or something...

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: ...That's enough of your disrespectful rubbish!

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: Focus on your noodles.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Have the preparations been made?

steps.name: Yumen Sentry
steps.text: Yumen has entered the highest state of alert, and the city defenses are all in position. The citizens have been evacuated, leaving twenty thousand soldiers and three thousand Tianshis able to take to the field at any time.

steps.name: Yumen Sentry
steps.text: They await your orders.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Let us see if the moons wax or wane in our favor tonight.

steps.name: Yumen Sentry
steps.text: General, the Grand Commandant's Messenger has arrived.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: At this hour?

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Where is the message, then?

steps.name: Yumen Sentry
steps.text: He didn't have one. All he had to deliver was... a box of mooncakes.

steps.name: Yumen Sentry
steps.text: He said the Grand Commandant had only one thing to say to you, General.

steps.name: Yumen Sentry
steps.text: 'Eat them while they're hot. Don't let them get cold.'
You received my notice, Lord Zuo.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: It has been a while... Are you faring well?

spans.text: been a while... Are you faring well?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: No need to be so tense. This pawnshop has long since closed its doors. No-one will be bothering us.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Why meet me alone?

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: Shouldn't I be asking you that, Lord Zuo?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: I opened this pawnshop on a whim during my stay in Baizao, and for a time, business was booming.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: Every day would see customers bring in all sorts of curios, scrolls, precious baubles and odd gemstones... In the end, many of them were taken by my wandering younger brother, and placed within his garden.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: The most curious thing was that all the customers who came by this shop had one thing in common: they were looking for me.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: You think far too highly of yourself.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: Well, since you have come to see me, does that not mean you have something to discuss, Lord Zuo? Perhaps I could answer one or two questions plaguing you?

spans.text: come to see me, does that not mean you have something to discuss, Lord Zuo? Perhaps I could answer one or two questions plaguing you?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: All I want to know is... Why have you come to Baizao?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: If that convict has decided now is the time to declare war on Yan, all that awaits him is death and destruction... But I'm sure he knows that already.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: Indeed. My elder brother is skilled at the art of the gridded board and naught else, though it is a formidable and well-honed skill at that.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: Do you still remember the Shanhaizhong who appeared in Yumen, Lord Zuo?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: During the Sui Regulator's analysis of the incident, we noticed traces of another Feranmut proxy's actions.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Wang is suspected of being involved...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: What are you trying to say?

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: I'm sure you remember, Lord Zuo, that during that hunt a thousand years ago, the Feranmut of Yan were either put to the sword, or banished.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: Has the Sui Regulator ever wondered, considering my brother was able to find one of them...

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: Could he, perhaps, have found more than just one?

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: During the many years since the incident, the Sui Regulator have watched closely his every movement within Yan's borders. But have they never considered the possibility that one of his weiqi stones might leave the country?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Don't underestimate our intelligence network. The Sui Regulator have never stopped keeping an eye on the Feranmut outside. If they make any sudden movements, our Feranmutologists will surely sense something.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: I'm sure they did. They should be on their way back to Yan right about now.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: Please treat this information as my humble gift to you, Lord Zuo. How you use it is for you to decide.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Why are you telling me this? You're one of the convict's conspirators, so why tell us his plans?

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: In truth... Though I am indeed in collaboration with my brother, our hearts are not as one. We have our differences.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: He insists on seeing a victor decided. I, on the other hand, prefer doing my business in a more... amicable fashion.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: As for why I chose you, Lord Zuo, I feel like we are... kindred spirits.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: I profess I have some skill in reading people. My intuition tells me we will have the opportunity to do business once again in the future.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: It is possible that the fate of us siblings will lie in your hands, Lord Zuo.

steps.name: Ji
steps.text: To be able to chat with you on this festive day, even but for a moment, is destiny at work... I hope that in the future, you can see me as a 'man' you can discuss things with.

steps.name: Careless Chef
steps.text: Aiyo!

steps.name: Lead Chef
steps.text: What's wrong?!

steps.name: Careless Chef
steps.text: Sorry! M—My hand just cramped! Couldn't hold it steady!

steps.name: Lead Chef
steps.text: You seriously... Bah!

steps.name: Careless Chef
steps.text: Sorry! I'll go back to the kitchen and get a new one!

steps.name: Lead Chef
steps.text: Do it quick! The mandarins are all seated already. Once the True Lung arrives, the banquet will start!

steps.name: Patrolling Soldier
steps.text: Do you need help, madam?

steps.name: Patrolling Soldier
steps.text: Madam?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: *cough*... I am here for the Feast of a Hundred Delicacies.

steps.name: Patrolling Soldier
steps.text: All the mandarins should have already been seated. May I ask why...

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Forgive me, I was delayed on the road here. I will head in right away.

steps.name: Patrolling Soldier
steps.text: Please wait a moment.

steps.name: Patrolling Soldier
steps.text: Madam, please show your invitation to the Feast.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Why? Is me standing here not invitation enough?

steps.name: Patrolling Soldier
steps.text: A routine inspection. I beg your pardon, madam.
My Lady! You dropped something of yours!

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: You...?

steps.name: Anxious Lady
steps.text: You left in such a rush! How could you not have noticed you dropped something so important? Good thing I spotted it.

steps.name: Patrolling Soldier
steps.text: Ah, Madam Tang of the Ministry of Revenue. Please forgive my earlier impertinence.

steps.name: Patrolling Soldier
steps.text: There are no further issues here, but the Feast is about to begin. Please take your seat as quickly as you can.

steps.name: Ning Yin
steps.text: That invitation is a forgery. It will only work the one time. Do take care when you're inside.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: I know you... You're one of the ladies at the Ning Manor.

steps.name: Ning Yin
steps.text: I'm also a friend of Blaze.

steps.name: Ning Yin
steps.text: I spotted her name on the chef roster and guessed at your plan.

steps.name: Ning Yin
steps.text: The rest, you will simply have to beg forgiveness from the True Lung after meeting him.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: But don't you know... If this case is reopened, you'll be ruined.

steps.name: Ning Yin
steps.text: But the one most heavily implicated by this case would be Blaze, no?

steps.name: Ning Yin
steps.text: Didn't you already agree to help her find the truth? What else is there to worry about?

steps.name: Ning Yin
steps.text: Besides... If you really do manage to pull back the curtain on all this, well, that's what I was after in the first place.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Thank you...
Despite all my years as a mandarin, I rarely set foot in the Forbidden City.
I see towering palaces press up against the sky, majestic and stately.
I see a banquet of incomparable bounty, each and every seat filled. The lamps are as bright as day, even as the moonlight envelops them.
But what I cannot see...
Is who hid away these names. Who does not want to see the truth come to light?
I suddenly recall the words.

a.text: 'Will you be able to handle the truth?'

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Yu Cheng... What exactly did you see...?

steps.name: Nervous Mandarin
steps.text: How strange. The Feast has already started, so why has His Imperial Majesty not yet arrived?

steps.name: Calm Mandarin
steps.text: No need to panic. His Imperial Majesty is busy. Something urgent might have come up. All we can do is wait.

steps.name: Nervous Mandarin
steps.text: I heard he's been ill for a while now. What if it is something to do with that?

steps.name: Calm Mandarin
steps.text: Shh! Stop blabbering.
Preposterous! Simply preposterous!
Don't you know where we are!? What right have you to obstruct a court mandarin?

steps.name: Junior Drillmaster
steps.text: What's all this noise about?

steps.name: Soldier
steps.text: This man says he's Assistant Minister Tang Jian of the Ministry of Revenue, but we've already checked, and every seat under the Ministry of Revenue is already accounted for...

steps.name: Angry Ministry of Revenue Mandarin
steps.text: I AM TANG JIAN! None of this 'he says' rubbish! Look, do you see this seal in my hand? Whose name is on it?!

spans.text: TANG JIAN! None of this 'he says' rubbish! Look, do you see this seal in my hand? Whose name is on it?!

steps.name: Junior Drillmaster
steps.text: ...Hmmm?
All falls silent.
Three blasts of the horn mark the seventh hour of the night.
The moons shine bright overhead, their light so clear they wash away all color.

steps.name: Officer of Ceremonial Rites
steps.text: All rise—
One by one, the mandarins stand, looking towards the center of the Feast with bated breath.
Waiting for the one meant to be seated at the head of the table—

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: I have something to report, Your Majesty!
Fire.
None knew where the burst of flame came from, but all it needed was a gust of autumn wind to engulf the entire banquet.
The flickering flames act like wild beasts, brandishing their fangs and claws as they pace about above the table.
The wind blows, and the beasts of fire grow and grow and grow with speed. The conflagration bloats and bulges, letting off unsettling noises. Some liken it to shouting, others to laughter—
Bizarre flames pour like falling rain. Having already tainted the Feast of a Hundred Delicacies, they flit and flicker as they climb up the faces of the panicking mandarins.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: What the... What's going on?
